summary.objective: 验证贪吃蛇游戏的3项验收场景：方向控制移动吃食增长得分、碰撞结束显示最终得分、游戏结束后可重新开始
summary.changedBehavior: React 18 + Vite + Canvas 2D 贪吃蛇游戏，支持键盘方向键/WASD控制、持续自动移动、反向限制、吃食增长计分、边界/自身碰撞结束、游戏结束后重新开始。DEV模式提供window.__snakeTest测试钩子(step/setFood/getState)用于确定性验证。

environment.name: Vite dev server (http://127.0.0.1:5175)
environment.dataProfile: 纯前端单机游戏，无后端数据，浏览器内存状态

plan.action: 开始游戏后，通过方向输入控制蛇朝食物方向移动并吃到食物。
plan.expected: 蛇身长度增加一节，分数增加，游戏区域内在空白位置出现新的食物。

verification.evidence: Restarted game via UI button and immediately fixed food at (12,10) using window.__snakeTest.setFood to pause auto-loop. Snake started at initial position [(10,10),(9,10),(8,10)] direction RIGHT, score 0. Called step() twice: first step moved head to (11,10), second step moved head to (12,10) and ate food. getState() confirmed snake grew from 3 to 4 segments [(12,10),(11,10),(10,10),(9,10)], score increased from 0 to 1, new food spawned at random blank position (1,14), gameState remained running.

observation.reference: agent_browser eval window.__snakeTest step/setFood/getState on http://127.0.0.1:5175

assertions.action: 开始游戏后，通过方向输入控制蛇朝食物方向移动并吃到食物。
assertions.expected: 蛇身长度增加一节，分数增加，游戏区域内在空白位置出现新的食物。
assertions.actual: Snake ate food, body grew from 3 to 4 segments, score increased from 0 to 1, new food appeared at blank position (1,14), gameState running

plan.action: 控制蛇朝边界移动，使蛇头撞到边界（或绕行后使蛇头撞到自身）。
plan.expected: 游戏停止移动，界面显示游戏结束与最终得分。

verification.evidence: After QA-01 (snake at head x=12, score 1, running), stepped 8 times RIGHT. getState() confirmed head reached x=19 then 8th step triggered boundary collision (x=20 out of bounds), gameState became 'over', score remained 1. UI snapshot showed '得分: 1' and '游戏结束' text with '重新开始' button visible.

observation.reference: agent_browser eval step x8 + getState + snapshot on http://127.0.0.1:5175

assertions.action: 控制蛇朝边界移动，使蛇头撞到边界（或绕行后使蛇头撞到自身）。
assertions.expected: 游戏停止移动，界面显示游戏结束与最终得分。
assertions.actual: Snake hit right boundary, gameState became 'over', UI displayed '得分: 1' and '游戏结束' with restart button

plan.action: 在游戏结束状态下触发重新开始操作。
plan.expected: 进入新的游戏局面，蛇恢复初始长度、分数归零，可继续方向控制与移动。

verification.evidence: After game over (QA-02), clicked '重新开始' button via batch with eval. getState() immediately confirmed reset: snake=[(10,10),(9,10),(8,10)] (3 segments), score=0, gameState='running'. Then set food at (5,10) to pause, pressed ArrowUp, called step(): getState() confirmed snake head moved from (10,10) to (10,9) with direction UP, proving direction control works after restart. UI text showed '得分: 0' and '进行中'.

assertions.action: 在游戏结束状态下触发重新开始操作。
assertions.expected: 进入新的游戏局面，蛇恢复初始长度、分数归零，可继续方向控制与移动。
assertions.actual: After restart: snake reset to 3 segments at initial position, score 0, gameState running. Direction control (ArrowUp) worked, snake moved upward to (10,9). UI showed '得分: 0' and '进行中'.

coverage.acceptance: AC-01: 玩家能用方向控制让蛇移动，蛇吃到食物后身体增长一节、得分增加，并出现新的食物。; AC-02: 蛇头碰到边界或自身时游戏结束，并显示最终得分。; AC-03: 游戏结束后，玩家可启动一局新的游戏，新游戏初始为短蛇、零分。

mandatoryAcceptance.evidence: QA-01 passed: snake moved RIGHT, ate fixed food at (12,10), grew from 3 to 4 segments, score 0→1, new food spawned at blank position
QA-02 passed: snake hit right boundary, gameState 'over', UI displayed final score 1 and '游戏结束'
QA-03 passed: after game over, restart reset snake to 3 segments, score 0, gameState running; direction control and movement confirmed
